Justin Bieber and Nicki Minaj's "Beauty and a Beat" (2012) is No. 11 on the Spotify global weekly chart with 18.3M streams (week of Oct 29, 2026).

Its 2026 run started after Bieber played it at Coachella on Apr 11, 2026; the song then reached No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200, 14 years after it came out.

Is it a real comeback, or pure nostalgia? 👇
